items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 3:1
items.html: The ascent of the concluding Malchut to the half of the Bina of the body, which is Tifferet, caused the departure of the light from all the vessels from the Tabur downward of AK, for the concluding Malchut withholds the upper light from shining from her and below. And the vessels remained an empty void, and the light ascended above the point of the new conclusion in Tifferet — that is, above the Tabur. (Item 3).
